The header row contains that title and blurb, and it does not contain Splits & stacks. The process is still running, and finish() exits 0.

cases.disposition_reason: CommonArgs::glyphs is --glyphs unicode (alias utf8) or --glyphs ascii. An explicit flag wins over detection. JUNIE_TUI_GLYPHS is the env override and these launches do not set it (src/cli.rs). Glyphs::UNICODE focus_bar is ▎, divider is │, scroll_thumb is ┃, scroll_track is ┆, and ellipsis is …. Glyphs::ASCII focus_bar is |, divider is |, scroll_thumb is #, scroll_track is :, and ellipsis is ~. ASCII must not paint ▎ or ┃ (src/theme.rs). render_vertical paints g.scroll_thumb and g.scroll_track (src/widgets/scrollbar.rs). The stored pair is one showcase process: --page textareas --glyphs ascii --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40, then a resize to 80×24, then back to 120×40. At 120×40 the nav focus gutter is | at column 1 row 9, fg Rgb(72, 224, 84) bg Rgb(23, 63, 28). The selected marker stays › at column 4 row 9 in the same colours. TreeView::selected_marker is hardcoded to › (src/bin/showcase/app.rs) and is not Glyphs::current, so ASCII mode still paints that one ›. The textarea thumb is # at column 85 rows 10 and 11, fg Rgb(128, 128, 128) bg Rgb(30, 30, 34). Column 85 rows 12 through 17 are :. The long-line ellipsis is ~ at column 83 rows 13 and 17. The screen has one |, two #, zero ┃, and zero ▎. The fixture line in src/bin/showcase/pages/textareas.rs is the numbered line that contains Review 日本語 · 👩‍💻 · cafe plus U+0301. The viewport shows 4. Run the integration suite and attach the report. and then the ellipsis. 日本語, the emoji ZWJ sequence, and the combining sequence are not on the 120×40 frame. The same clip happens with --glyphs unicode, where the gutter is ▎ at column 1 row 9, the thumb is ┃ at column 85 rows 10 and 11 rather than #, the track is ┆, and the ellipsis is …. That Unicode shell ends with kill_child. The terminal then resizes to 80×24. The stored narrow frame is taken while the ASCII page is still up, after the gutter and the thumbs are on screen, and before the return to 120×40. The gutter | and the › marker stay at row 9. A vertical # thumb is column 79 rows 7 through 10, fg Rgb(128, 128, 128) bg Rgb(0, 0, 0). A horizontal # thumb is row 21 columns 21 through 73, the same ink. The narrow frame has 57 # cells, one |, zero ┃, and zero ▎. It still shows 4. Run the integration suite and attach the report. and still does not show 日本語, the emoji, or the combining sequence. The header blurb is clipped to ho…. The page returns to 120×40 with the wide gutter and thumb, then finish() exits 0. The check compares the stored frames. showcase --page splits --glyphs ascii: Splitter::render_held paints divider at rest and scroll_thumb while hovered or pressed (src/widgets/splitter.rs). The resting outer seam is column 54 rows 11 through 26, | fg Rgb(77, 77, 77) bg Rgb(17, 17, 17), with no ┃ and no │ on that column. The screen has zero ┃, zero │, and zero ▎, and the nav gutter is | at column 1 row 14. The same page with --glyphs unicode paints │ on that column and ▎ at column 1 row 14. Those shells end with kill_child. tablepro --glyphs ascii paints a focus gutter | at column 3 row 5, fg Rgb(72, 224, 84) bg Rgb(0, 0, 0), and the panel borders as |. It has 69 | cells, zero ┃, and zero ▎. The two # cells at column 8 rows 11 and 12, fg Rgb(255, 107, 107), are Glyphs::ASCII.env_production on Analytics and Production (src/bin/tablepro/connections.rs copies theme.glyphs and uses glyphs.env). They are not a scrollbar thumb. That shell ends with kill_child. holla --scenario activities-multi --glyphs ascii paints a focus gutter | at column 1 row 4, fg Rgb(72, 224, 84) bg Rgb(30, 30, 34), on the Search actions row. It has five | cells, zero #, zero ┃, and zero ▎. The other | cells sit on the tab row and the status row. The running result rows still include a hardcoded ⠋ (src/bin/holla/domain/catalog.rs), which is not a gutter or a thumb. That shell ends with kill_child. jackin --scenario hard-cases, with the test clock off and no --frame, --glyphs ascii paints a focus gutter | at column 3 row 3, fg Rgb(72, 224, 84) bg Rgb(23, 63, 28), on the Current directory row. Resting vertical rules are | fg Rgb(77, 77, 77) bg Rgb(0, 0, 0), including the manager seam. The screen has zero ┃, zero │, zero ▎, and zero #. There is no scrollbar thumb.
